title: Recompute the required X102 coefficient in Y71
body:
## Summary
- The archived fixed-cover correction has 4,992 nonzero entries. The entry for target Y71 and source X102 is `-4`, so its coefficient is `-1/2`.
- The channel path of X102 has 5 frames and the path of Y71 has 7. Those frames are disjoint, so this pair has no direct contact.
- No selected frontier change and no new exponent. The pooled recurrence and its 2,309 edges are not replayed.
